18'-11" OVERALL · STUDY WALL CORNER TO THE DRESSING CORNER

svg.text: CUT AT 1000 · SCALE 1:25 · ROOM BELOW, WALL ABOVE
Option C: 5 equal panels, lamps in 1, 3, 5 and the return.
One narrow panel on the wall past the door.
Moulding, rail and skirting painted the wall colour.
SELECTED after four schemes: the rail is the study counter
band carried round the corner, and it dies into the casing.
Skirting is white marble, 4 in, already laid.
Casing 2 in lining + 4 in moulding = 6 in, 1068 overall;
crown at 8 ft 8 in, and the tall panels stop on that
line, not the leaf head at 7 ft 7 in.
Dressing door (27 Sept tape): leaf 2 ft 6 in, 2 ft 10 in with frame;
2 ft 3 in of wall to the corner. OPEN: the frame lands 13 ft 10
from the study corner, 4 in off the 13 ft 6 taped on 18 Sept.
WHITE MARBLE, ALREADY LAID · SQUARE WITH A SMALL TOP CHAMFER
BRASS, FABRIC SHADES · CENTRED IN PANEL

g.text: 20 — the dressing door re-set to the owner's 27 Sept tape: 2 ft 6 in leaf, 2 ft 10 in with frame, 2 ft 3 in of wall to the corner
